description: Implementation of OSWindow for X11, handling window creation, event processing, and input handling on X11 systems.

classes.name: X11Window
classes.description: Class implementing OSWindow for X11, managing window lifecycle, event processing, and input.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the X11 window with specified name, width, and height.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the window and releases resources.

methods.name: setMousePosition
methods.description: Sets the mouse cursor position within the window.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the window and waits for the resize to complete.

methods.name: signalTestEvent
methods.description: Sends a test event to the window.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes individual X11 events and translates them into internal events.
